panels.description: TJ's lost leg sinks among old mine rails beneath the lake. Leave center clear for the sound effect.
The barge becomes a distant light and the damaged drone sparks above the water. Leave upper area open.
Alex stands rigid while the granddaughter looks from him to TJ's head. Leave upper space for dialogue.
The detached leg's magnet pulses in dark water among rails. Leave negative space for the sound effect.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Not without making the lake a battlefield.
